text_block_list.text:
While searching for the Trainer, Taiki 
Shuttle tells them that Hishi Akebono's 
race is something only Hishi Akebono can 
run.

Hishi Akebono nods vigorously at those 
words. She drags Trainer off to the 
kitchen... and starts cooking chanko nabe!

She then shares her desire to keep running 
as the "big and powerful" Hishi Akebono 
that the audience expects to see.

Even if it shortens her racing career, she 
wants to preserve her own "flavor." The 
chanko nabe she served had that very same, 
familiar "flavor."

—A "taste" that meets expectations holds a 
special kind of deliciousness. Deciding 
not to change her racing style, she set 
her sights on running in the Mile 
Championship!
